'''Josh Koziura''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 105 from Franklin, TN.<ref name="sm-fan" /> His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 he also played [[Young Jedi]], finishing 4th in YJ Opposites.<ref name="dc99yj20_5">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_5.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Opposites], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108191900/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_5.html Internet Archive]</ref>
